title: Eric Wang's secret UFO work at Kirtland, per his wife
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Bill Steinman gets in touch with his wife uh Maria Wing and she says, "Oh yeah, he worked at Kirtland Air Force Base. He worked on some, you know, secret UFO related stuff."

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a UFO researcher named Bill Steinman contacted Maria Wang, the wife of a scientist named Eric Wang. According to Michels, she told Steinman that her husband worked at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico in the 1950s and 60s on secret UFO-related projects, which, if true, would mean the government had scientists quietly studying the subject.
